props.heading: Slow-cooked, wood-fired, made to be shared
props.sub: A neighbourhood kitchen serving seasonal plates, fresh bread and honest coffee since 2014.

props.label: Our Story
props.heading: Cooked the long way, on purpose
props.body:
We started with one wood-fired oven and a short menu we could cook properly. That has not really changed.

Everything is prepped in-house each morning — the bread, the stocks, the sauces. We buy produce from growers we have worked with for years, so the menu shifts a little with every season.

pillars.title: Seasonal produce
pillars.text: Sourced weekly from local farms, so the menu changes as the season does.

pillars.title: Baked every morning
pillars.text: Sourdough and focaccia out of the oven before we open the doors.

pillars.title: Wood-fired kitchen
pillars.text: Live fire cooking that gives everything its char and depth.

pillars.title: Warm, unfussy service
pillars.text: Good food without the ceremony — come as you are.

props.label: From the Kitchen
props.heading: Menu highlights
props.sub: A few of the plates our regulars keep coming back for. The full menu changes with the season.

items.title: Smoked Chicken & Pineapple Pizza
items.desc: Barbecue chicken, pineapple, red onion and coriander on a 48-hour fermented base.

items.title: Rainbow Protein Bowl
items.desc: Tofu, edamame, sweetcorn, egg and crisp greens with a toasted sesame dressing.

items.title: Herb-Roasted Chicken
items.desc: Thyme-roasted chicken with garlic kale and pomegranate.

items.title: Garden Table Salad
items.desc: Mixed leaves, feta, walnuts, olives and carrot with a citrus vinaigrette.

items.title: Buttermilk Pancakes
items.desc: Stacked with maple syrup, fresh banana and toasted almond.

items.title: House Curry & Basmati
items.desc: Slow-simmered curry finished with cream and coriander, served with steamed basmati.

images.alt: A plate going out to the table

items.quote: The margherita is the best in the city, and I have tried most of them. We end up here almost every other weekend.
items.name: Ananya Rao

items.quote: Booked the back room for my parents' anniversary. They handled everything and the food came out perfectly timed.
items.name: Vikram Shetty

items.quote: Genuinely good vegetarian options that are not an afterthought. The grain bowl is superb.
items.name: Meera Iyer

props.label: Timings
props.heading: When we're open
props.note: Kitchen closes 30 minutes before closing time. Last orders for the wood-fired oven at 10:15 PM.

props.heading: Planning dinner, or something bigger?
props.sub: Walk-ins are always welcome. For groups of six or more, or the private room, drop us a message and we'll sort it out.

props.label: Find Us
props.heading: Reservations & enquiries
props.sub: Tell us the date, time and how many of you there are — we'll confirm within the hour.
